_説明: 仕事と職場チャンネルの決まった登場人物（手順書 §5）。場面の絵に人を出す時は、この中から選んで script.json のカットに "chars": ["kenji"] と書く。make_images_lovart.py が設定画（sheet）を添付して、顔・髪・服を全部の回でそろえる。設定画が無ければ先に作る（Lovart の無料モード）。型B・C の主役は、script.json の "characters" にその回だけの人物を書く（設定画は作業フォルダの images\_chars\ にできる）

kenji.name: 健二（45歳・課長）
kenji.desc_en: Kenji, a 45-year-old Japanese office worker and section manager: average build, short black hair slightly grey at the temples, tired but kind eyes, wears a navy suit jacket, a white shirt and a plain dark navy tie.

mai.name: 麻衣（26歳・入社3年目）
mai.desc_en: Mai, a 26-year-old Japanese office worker in her third year at the company: slim, shoulder-length dark brown hair tied in a low ponytail, round friendly face, wears a beige knit cardigan over a white blouse and navy straight trousers.

shigeru.name: 茂（58歳・ベテラン社員）
shigeru.desc_en: Shigeru, a 58-year-old Japanese veteran employee: lean, short grey hair, thin face with deep smile lines, wears a grey knit vest over a light blue collared shirt and dark grey trousers.

yoko.name: 陽子（41歳・パートで働く母）
yoko.desc_en: Yoko, a 41-year-old Japanese part-time worker and mother of two: medium build, chin-length black bob haircut, gentle tired smile, wears a mustard-yellow knit sweater and dark blue jeans.
